notes: Nintendo Switch 2 is only compatible with microSD Express cards for expandable game and data storage.
Ordinary microSD, microSDHC, and microSDXC cards that do not support the microSD Express standard cannot be used for normal expandable storage.
Nintendo supports microSD Express cards up to 2 TB.
A system update via the internet is required the first time a microSD Express card is used.
No SD Express Speed Class such as E150 or E300 is required by Nintendo; compatibility is based on meeting the microSD Express standard.

sources.title: microSD Card and microSD Express Card Compatibility with Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch

claims.evidence: Nintendo documents microSD Express as the expandable memory-card standard used by Nintendo Switch 2.
Nintendo explicitly states that Nintendo Switch 2 is compatible with the microSD Express standard.
Nintendo states that Nintendo Switch 2 is only compatible with microSD Express cards.
Nintendo specifies support for microSD Express cards with capacities up to 2TB.
